ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Five children each have a black square, a grey triangle and a white circle made up of paper. The children place the three shapes on top of each other as seen in the pictures. In how many pictures was the triangles placed after the square?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: From left to right, there are a total of five overlapping figures. Looking only at the gray triangle and the black square: In the 1st figure, the gray triangle covers the middle-lower part of the black square; in the 2nd figure, the black square blocks the middle part of the gray triangle, with only the top end and the two sides of the triangle exposed; in the 3rd figure, the black square is clearly covering the gray triangle in front, with only the top end and the two bottom sides of the triangle exposed; in the 4th figure, the gray triangle is visible in front of the lower part of the black square, covering the lower area of the square; in the 5th figure, the gray triangle covers the black square in front. raw_record.question_text: Five children each have a black square, a grey triangle, and a white circle made of paper. The children place the three shapes on top of each other as seen in the pictures. In how many pictures was the triangle placed after the square?

method.method_draft: Describe the five pictures from left to right, focusing only on the grey triangle and black square. Use visible overlap to decide order: if the triangle covers part of the square, then the triangle was placed after the square; if the square hides the triangle, then the triangle was placed before the square. Picture 1: the large grey triangle is in front of the black square, so count it. Picture 2: the black square is in front of the triangle, so do not count it. Picture 3: the black square covers the triangle, so do not count it. Picture 4: the grey triangle is visible in front of the lower part of the square, so count it. Picture 5: the grey triangle covers the square, so count it. Total counted pictures: 3.

图像描述：从左到右共有五幅叠放图形。只看灰色三角形和黑色正方形：第1幅中，灰色三角形盖住了黑色正方形的中下部分；第2幅中，黑色正方形挡住了灰色三角形的中间部分，只露出三角形的顶端和两侧；第3幅中，黑色正方形明显盖在灰色三角形前面，只露出三角形的顶端和底部两侧；第4幅中，灰色三角形在黑色正方形下部前方可见，遮住了正方形的下部区域；第5幅中，灰色三角形盖在黑色正方形前面。
推理：如果灰色三角形盖住黑色正方形，说明三角形是在正方形之后放的；如果黑色正方形盖住灰色三角形，说明三角形是在正方形之前放的。第1、4、5幅满足三角形在正方形之后放；第2、3幅不满足。因此共有3幅。
